channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily curated opinion and blog posts from tech researchers and thinkers

item.title: Scott Aaronson: The stochastic parrots have apparently proved the Riemann Hypothesis
item.description: Levent Alpöge claims an Anthropic model produced a 17.4-million-line Lean proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis — Aaronson on why, verified or not, the timeline for AI math has collapsed.

item.title: Terry Tao: Unforced Euler singularity, unforced Navier-Stokes singularity, and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
item.description: Tao's sober digest of the three AI-assisted claims landing the same day — Euler and Navier-Stokes blowup proofs plus the GRH — ranked by how digested each one actually is.

item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: On Dwarkesh Patel's November 2026 Podcast With Paul Christiano
item.description: Christiano's message: meaningful risk of AI takeover within even the next 6–12 months — Zvi unpacks what that would actually look like.

item.title: Andrew Ng: Jensen Huang's Legacy and Future (The Batch #380)
item.description: Ng's personal reflection on Jensen's resignation — the early GPU bet on deep learning, the ecosystem he built, and what Nvidia loses without him.
